title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day! — Episode7 Emboldening Words

meta.Event Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hoshino.
I never would've guessed we'd run into each other here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Can I ask what you two are doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was just on my way to school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I take night classes.
We have our opening ceremony in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At night? I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My opening ceremony was also today, but that happened earlier.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Kanade, I thought you were enrolled in a correspondence school. They hold opening ceremonies?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Other schools might handle these things differently, but mine holds them like normal. They ask that we be in attendance whenever we can...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena contacted me after it ended and we were talking at a diner until just a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How were things at school today, Ichika?
Everyone's in new classes and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, yes.
Honami and I are in the same class now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're with Ms. Mochizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's great to hear that you're both in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I was really glad to know we'll be together.
We have two others in our band who were both placed in another class, which also made them happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And during practice just now, we got really into it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
This kind of fresh new beginning really gives you a boost, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It does.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I can't say this for sure...
But after talking with everyone today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I was emboldened by their motivation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What we're after...
We know surpassing it won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I don't care how hard the road up ahead is. I'm going to do my absolute best and leave no regrets.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to work lots and lots for MORE MORE JUMP! I know that things might be tougher than before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm gonna keep doing what I can to spread hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright!
Once I get home, I'll put on my new shoes and go for a run!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to keep building up my stamina if I'm going to make more people smile!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all looking forward to making their dreams come true by overcoming any obstacles that come their way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing that made me want to do the same and try just as hard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to give you my diary of things...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
I think I understand what you're saying.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hearing your story is making me want to try harder as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: During the opening ceremony today, I started thinking more about the future...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is more of a personal matter, but a lot of things have been happening recently that required careful attention.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we were talking about that at the diner just now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't say that I've been able to set goals for myself and do what I can to accomplish them like you and the others, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But your story did make me want to try harder moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I didn't say much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, if what happened to me today is giving you a little extra push... Then I'm glad I told you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I should get going.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't mean to keep you so long...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
See you, Ichika! And we'll talk again later tonight, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, good luck at school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I should start heading home as well...
See you later, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay! See you!
